title: By road and by sea: the fastest way from Rome to anywhere in the Roman Empire
excerpt: By road alone Carthage was 210 days' walk from Rome. With a ship it was 6. I added the sea to my map of Roman roads, with sailing speeds from ancient voyages and the summer etesian winds.
seo_description: Fastest travel times from Rome across the Roman Empire by road and by sea, with ancient sailing speeds and the summer winds.
header_alt: Title card reading 'By road and by sea' in black on cream, beside a map of the Mediterranean where roads and sea are coloured by days from Rome, red and orange around Italy and across the sea to Africa and Egypt, green and blue further away. Text: Carthage 210 days by road, 6 with a ship; Alexandria 180 days, or 12.
